technology_name: Probiotic Chocolate with Prebiotic Fibres from Kerala's Seasonal Fruits
institution: KSCSTE- Centre of Excellence in Microbiome (CoEM)
problem_solved: Underutilization of seasonal regional fruits leading to high food waste, combined with a lack of indulgent, clean-label functional food options that support preventive gut health.
description: A functional food product incorporating live probiotic cultures inside a premium chocolate base enriched with natural prebiotic fibers. The fibers are derived from underutilized, seasonal indigenous fruits of Kerala, including jackfruit, Indian apple, banana, mango, and pineapple. This formulation delivers active gut-microbiome support along with naturally occurring dietary fibers, antioxidants, and essential micronutrients. The clean-label processing model focuses on high-value post-harvest resource utilization to deliver a healthy wellness snack.
applications:
• Premium wellness confectionery manufacturing and retail packaging

• Industrial scale extraction of prebiotic fibers from indigenous tropical fruits

• Strategic sourcing networks with agricultural cooperatives for seasonal fruit processing

• E-commerce and boutique retail distribution targeting the functional health food market
contact_person: Dr. Mahesh S Krishna & Dr. Sabu Thomas
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
